trip.title: Many-many countries
trip.welcome: I'm soo happy to see you!
ticket.museum.who: 2 adults · show it at the entrance
d1.title: Arrival
d1.note: A long day. Drink water and keep passports in an inside pocket.
d2.title: Old City
d2.note: Lots of walking today: wear comfortable shoes. Mum, bring a scarf for the mosque.
d3.title: Palace and Bazaar
d3.note: The Grand Bazaar is busy. Keep bags in front of you and agree the price before you pay.
d4.title: Bosphorus
d4.note: Windy on the water. Take a jacket.
d5.title: Flying home
d5.note: Check out before {time}. Passports go in the hand luggage.
ev.checkin.note: Show passports and the flight ticket.
ev.landing.note: Follow the “Exit / Çıkış” signs. The driver holds a sign with our family name.
ev.hotelCheckin.note: Room {room}. Breakfast is on the top floor.
ev.hagia.note: Women cover their hair. Shoes off inside; shoe bags are at the door.
ev.blueMosque.note: Closed to visitors during prayers. If it is closed, we wait in the garden.
ev.topkapi.note: About 3 hours. There is a café with a sea view inside.
ev.grandBazaar.note: If we lose each other, meet at the gate where we came in.
ev.fish.note: Balık ekmek: grilled fish in bread, a local classic.
ev.galata.note: A lift goes most of the way up, then a few stairs.
ev.checkout.note: Leave the key at reception. Check the safe!
help.mike.note: Our phone. Also on Viber and Telegram.
help.lost.1: Stay where you are. Don’t walk off to look for us.
help.lost.2: Call {first}. If there is no answer, call {second}.
help.lost.3: No battery or no signal? Ask a shop or café to call for you. Show them the phrase “Please call this number”.
help.lost.4: Can’t reach anyone? Take a taxi to the hotel and show the driver the Taxi card.
help.insurance.note: Call them before going to a doctor. They tell you which clinic to use.
help.consulate.name: Consulate in Istanbul
list.daily: Every morning before we go out
list.packing.8: Plug adapter? Turkey uses type F, like most of Europe
list.home.4: Look under the beds and in the bathroom
list.home.5: Some lira left for the taxi
